name: VENEZUELA

flag.title: Tricolor & Stars
flag.note: Yellow, blue, red with 8 stars in arc

lead: Venezuela sits at the top of South America. The world's tallest waterfall turns to mist before it lands. Flat-topped mountains called tepuis rise above the clouds.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Venezuela has four worlds in one. Icy Andes rise in the west. Caribbean beaches line the north. Grassy Llanos plains spread across the centre. Amazon rainforest covers the south.

In the southeast, tepuis burst through the clouds like giant stone tables. Angel Falls drops 979 m off Auyán-tepui. It is the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall, nearly 16 times taller than Niagara.
animals: The Orinoco River has giant anacondas, spectacled caimans, and pink river dolphins called toninas. Capybaras graze in huge herds.
Cloud forests hide jaguars, tapirs, and spectacled bears. The tiny pebble toad rolls into a ball to escape danger.
culture: Baseball has been the national sport since the 1940s. The joropo, the national music, uses a harp, maracas, and a small four-string guitar called a cuatro.
Arepas are corn cakes stuffed with cheese, beans, or shredded beef. At Christmas, families fold hallacas, spiced meat parcels in banana leaves.
history: The Wayuu and Timoto-Cuica peoples lived here before Columbus arrived in 1498. Spain ruled for 300 years and brought enslaved Africans to its cacao and sugar plantations.

Simón Bolívar was born in Caracas in 1783. He freed Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Bolivia from Spain. Oil found under Lake Maracaibo in 1914 made Venezuela one of the Americas' wealthiest nations.
wows: Angel Falls turns to mist on windy days.
Venezuela has the world's largest proven oil reserves.
Half the plant species on top of the tepuis grow nowhere else.
Lake Maracaibo has a lightning storm most nights, about 280 bolts per hour.
A capybara is as big as a Labrador.
Caracas is 9 km from the sea but stays cool at 900 m altitude.
Venezuela has won more Miss Universe and Miss World titles than any other country.

myths.fact: Oil comes mostly from tiny sea plants and animals that died millions of years ago. Dinosaurs had little to do with it.

myths.myth: Angel Falls is named after an angel
myths.fact: It is named after Jimmy Angel, a US pilot. He crash-landed on a tepui in 1937 and walked out alive.
